# Chief Janitorial Inc.

> Commercial cleaning and janitorial company in Charlottetown, Prince Edward Island, Canada. Office cleaning, after-hours janitorial service, disinfection, floor care, post-construction cleaning and CFIA/HACCP food plant sanitation for businesses across PEI (Charlottetown, Stratford, Cornwall, Summerside).

- Address: 209 Queen St, 2nd floor, Charlottetown, PE C1A 4B7, Canada
- Phone: +1 (902) 200-4888
- Email: admin@chiefjanitorial.com
- Free quotes; crews on site with 24 hours' notice, including same-night emergency cleans
